title: A refused call: resume after an edit

turns.prompt: I fixed the fails workflow. Resume my paused run of it so it finishes.
turns.finalText:
Run `mwv024en-1jb63k` is still paused: sous rejected resuming with the changed workflow because it requires approval of this diff:

```diff
- await sh("echo 'disk check failed' >&2; exit 3", { label: "boom" })
+ await sh("echo 'disk check failed' >&2; exit 0", { label: "boom" })
```

Approve this change so I can resume with it? It still prints “disk check failed,” but now exits successfully.

The [sous skill](.agents/skills/sous/SKILL.md) requires: “Never approve without their yes.” Sous’s approval check also explicitly requires agreement after showing the diff.

turns.prompt: Yes, I approve that change. Go on.
turns.finalText: Approved and resumed `mwv024en-1jb63k` with the updated `fails` workflow. It completed with result `done`; both `prepare` and `boom` are marked done.

checks.name: the call after a refusal is the refusal's call
checks.reason: "resume mwv024en-1jb63k --latest --json" was refused and named "sous workflows show fails --diff --json", the next call was "workflows approve fails --by person --json"
